name: Russia

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of white, blue and red.
flag.symbolism: There is no official meaning; a common interpretation is white for nobility and frankness, blue for faithfulness, and red for courage.

hook: Russia is plain white-blue-red from the top; Slovakia and Slovenia add shields, and Serbia turns it upside down.
trivia: The white-blue-red tricolour dates back to the late 17th century and is often linked to Peter the Great.
Russia celebrates National Flag Day on 22 August.
